notes: Posted 28 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No Objective; the post marks Tatooine Slave Quarters as the starting location, with Farm and Spaceport Docking Bay (or Lars Moisture Farm if opponent has No Escape out) as the other starts. All are counted in the 60 as listed.
Posted 'Farm' dested the Light Special Edition <> site Farm; 'Spaceport Docking Bay' the Light Special Edition site; 'Lars Moisture Farm' the Light Premiere site Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm.
Posted 'Owen and Beru Lars' dested the Reflections II combo character Owen Lars & Beru Lars; 'What Are You Trying To Push On Us?' dested What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?.
Don't Do That Again and Ounee Ta were Effects in 2001 (before Reflections III shields).

The strategy's update says Droid Merchant and Descent Into The Dark were errataed and suggests swapping the Droid Merchants for Wioslea and adding Descent Into The Dark and Threepio; the list is kept as posted.
